name: Houzuki Yui
source: A classmate of [url=http://vndb.org/c12896]Sayaka's[/url] who agrees to be adopted by [url=http://vndb.org/c12894]Daichi[/url] despite the fact that both her parents are still alive. When she is adopted, she becomes the youngest of the Houzuki sisters.
translation: A classmate of [url=http://vndb.org/c12896]Sayaka's[/url] who agrees to be adopted by [url=http://vndb.org/c12894]Daichi[/url] despite the fact that both her parents are still alive. When she is adopted, she becomes the youngest of the Houzuki sisters.
